description: Estimates the extra South African income tax caused by crypto in one tax year, for an individual, company or trust: applies the CGT annual exclusion (R50,000 for individuals from 1 March 2026), the 40% or 80% inclusion rate, the tax tables and age rebates, and shows tax with and without the crypto, the marginal rate and any capital loss to carry forward.

age.description: Individuals: age on the last day of the tax year. Default 40

brought_forward_capital_loss.description: Assessed capital loss from earlier years. Default 0

crypto_net_capital_gain.description: Net capital gain (or loss, negative) on crypto held as an investment

crypto_revenue_income.description: Crypto amounts taxed as ordinary income: trading profits, mining, staking, crypto salary. Default 0

other_net_capital_gain.description: Net capital gain on other assets in the same year (the exclusion is shared). Default 0

other_taxable_income.description: Taxable income from everything else, in rand. Default 0

tax_year.description: Year the tax year ends, e.g. 2027 for 1 March 2026 – 28 February 2027. Default: current tax year

taxpayer.description: Type of taxpayer: individual, company, trust or special_trust. Default individual

name: crypto_tax_estimate
title: Estimate SA tax on crypto gains and income for a tax year
